spec.name: Piano Accordion (Italian Mother-of-Pearl)
spec.description: A full-size 41-key piano accordion standing upright on its bass end, in a pearly celluloid finish with gold trim, a red bellows and a chrome grille.
spec.layout: The accordion stands upright on the floor, resting on its bass-end foot pads (the tabs of the left-hand end), in its rest pose with the bellows half-open. Y is the long axis of the instrument. From the bottom (y=0) up: the bass (left-hand) box on the floor, with the grille and bass buttons facing +Z; the bellows in the middle, whose pleats run along y and are red with white pearl-edged gold-trimmed corners; the treble (right-hand) box on top, whose front face (+Z) carries the piano keyboard (white keys with black sharps, a fine gold keyboard rail), with the treble grille on the +X side and the register switches on the top. The piano keyboard is in the front face, the player's side. Straps (red leather with gold buckles) run on the back (-Z). Mother-of-pearl style: the box bodies are a creamy iridescent pearl in flat colours, using a pale cream, a pink-lilac and an aqua-blue as inlaid swirl or diamond bands, chased with gold filigree and rhinestone-like small studs. Every part wears the pearl with gold edging and a crimson bellows, to read as Italian.

parts.builds: Left-hand bass box, 0.38 wide (x) by 0.22 deep (z) by 0.125 tall, as a faceted pearl box with bevelled gold edge trim, four little foot pads on the floor, the front +Z face carrying 6 rows of round pearl bass buttons with gold rims, a grille of dark slats with a chrome frame on the +X side, inlaid pink and aqua diamond panels, gold filigree corner pieces and a cluster of studs, plus a leather wrist strap on the -X side.
parts.attaches: Top face at bassTop meets the bellows bottom. Rides joint bassBox.

parts.builds: Red bellows with about 14 pleats stacked along y between y=0.125 and 0.295, each pleat a thin trapezoid box in bellowsRed alternating with bellowsDark folds, tapering slightly at the ends, with white pearl and gold corner protectors on all 4 vertical edges, gold pleat-edge lines, and a pair of leather bellows straps with gold buckles on the -Z side.
parts.attaches: Bottom at bellowsBottom, top at bellowsTop. Rides joint bellows.

parts.builds: Right-hand treble box, 0.4 wide by 0.23 deep by 0.125 tall, the pearl shell with pink and aqua inlaid bands, gold edge trim, the +X side carrying a chrome grille with slats, and the top with a gold-edged cap. Its back face has a leather back plate and two red shoulder straps with gold slides and buckles hanging down the -Z side. Includes the pearl inlay patterns, studs and gold filigree swirls on the sides and top, and a chrome logo plate with a small gold emblem.
parts.attaches: Bottom at trebleBottom; keyboard overhang is built by the keyboard part. Rides joint trebleBox.

parts.builds: Piano keyboard on the front +Z face of the treble box: 26 white keys 0.0125 wide across x from -0.16 to 0.16 and 0.075 long (y), with a gold rail along the top and bottom, 18 black sharp keys in the 2-3 groups, a pearl key bed, a row of 5 register switches in pearl above the keys with gold tips, and a little gold-lettered nameplate drawn as a small gold slab.
parts.attaches: Sits on the treble box front at keyboardFront. Rides joint trebleBox.
